name: spotlight-testimonial
blurb: Full-screen testimonial rotator with scroll-triggered staggered entrance animations.
description: Centered testimonial showcase with auto-rotating quotes (3s interval), highlighted phrase in italics, author avatar/name/role, quote icon, and dot navigation. All elements use TimelineAnimation for scroll-based reveal with staggered timing.
use_when: Full-screen sections where testimonials need to be the hero content with smooth entrance animations.
avoid_when: When testimonials should be compact or inline — this is always full-height.
a11y: Dot navigation buttons have aria-labels. All text is accessible. Animations are scroll-triggered but no prefers-reduced-motion support.
